description: This file contains the implementation of the Uri class in the Slim Framework's PSR-7 HTTP message library. It provides methods for constructing, manipulating, and stringifying HTTP URIs, including handling schemes, hosts, ports, paths, queries, and fragments.

classes.name: Uri
classes.description: Implementation of the PSR-7 UriInterface, providing methods for URI manipulation and string conversion.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new Uri instance with specified components.

methods.name: withScheme
methods.description: Returns a new Uri instance with the specified scheme.

methods.name: getAuthority
methods.description: Returns the authority component of the URI.

methods.name: getUserInfo
methods.description: Returns the user info part of the URI.

methods.name: withUserInfo
methods.description: Returns a new Uri instance with updated user info.

methods.name: withHost
methods.description: Returns a new Uri instance with a different host.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number if present and not default for the scheme.

methods.name: withPort
methods.description: Returns a new Uri instance with a specific port.

methods.name: withPath
methods.description: Returns a new Uri instance with a different path.

methods.name: withQuery
methods.description: Returns a new Uri instance with updated query.

methods.name: withFragment
methods.description: Returns a new Uri instance with a different fragment.
